fixed: Searching for a figure by another of its names, such as "do si do", now also finds lines you typed in those words, in a dance of any form, as well as every figure of that call.
added: A square's right and left through with a full courtesy turn says "with a full turn" in its figure line, and you can search for it by those words. A copy of the call made in the Glossary says it too.

fixed: FilterCompiler matches each free-text word also with no move name or keyword rewritten (its role words still canonical), and DanceRepository.searchText matches the query's role-canonical words too, so a move keyword no longer hides text typed in its words.

FilterCompiler also reads a phrase kept whole only by an English or square move's name or keyword word by word, as a contra-only search split it; contra's own names and keywords, those added since v0.10.0-beta included, still count as one phrase.
changed: Square taxonomy v1 (unreleased, amended): sq_right_left_through's renderTemplate gains {fullTurn}, which FigureRenderer writes as "with a full turn" in display and canonical text, and userFigureSeedFromMove takes as the copied flag's label.
